section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses the historical focus on negative body image research and advocates for a greater investment in positive body image, particularly body appreciation. It explores the concepts of shame (external and internal) and self-compassion in relation to body image. The present study aims to clarify the relationships between body appreciation, body mass index, shame, and self-compassion, specifically examining the mediating role of self-compassion in the association between external shame and body appreciation in a sample of young male and female adults, and analyzing sex differences.
